name: Adobe Podcast
tagline: Adobe Podcast (now Adobe Enhance Speech) is a web-based AI audio tool that removes background noise and enhances voice recordings to studio quality. Podcasters and remote workers upload any audio clip and the AI scrubs hiss, echo, and ambient sound in seconds. It also offers a full AI-powered podcast recording and editing environment.
